body.statement:
For probability laws \(\mu,
u\) on the compact Euclidean cube \(\mathcal Y\), \[W_1(\mu,
u)=\sup\left\{\int_{\mathcal Y}f\,d(\mu-
u):f:\mathcal Y	o\mathbb R,\ |f(y)-f(y')|\le\lVert y-y'Vert_2	ext{ for all }y,y'\in\mathcal Yight\}.\]

source.locator: Section 1.1, display immediately following the phrase `dual form of Wasserstein-1' in arXiv:1902.01778v4
source.verbatim_statement: \(W_{1}(\mu,\nu)=\sup_{f\in\mathrm{Lip}}\int f(\mathrm{d}\mu-\mathrm{d}\nu)\), where the supremum is taken over all 1-Lipschitz functions.

attestation.note: Transcribed from Niles-Weed and Berthet, arXiv:1902.01778v4, Section 1.1, displayed dual form of Wasserstein-1.
